attributes.description:
Weights assigned to the features (coefficients in the primal
problem). This is only available in the case of a linear kernel.

`coef_` is readonly property derived from `dual_coef_` and
`support_vectors_`.
attributes.name: coef_
attributes.type_doc: ndarray or sparse array/matrix of shape (1, n_features)

attributes.description:
Coefficients of the support vector in the decision function.
If `X` is sparse, these will also be sparse.
attributes.name: dual_coef_
attributes.type_doc: ndarray or sparse array/matrix of shape (1, n_SV)

attributes.description: 0 if correctly fitted, 1 otherwise (will raise warning)
attributes.name: fit_status_

attributes.description:
Number of features seen during :term:`fit`.

.. versionadded:: 0.24
attributes.name: n_features_in_

attributes.description:
Names of features seen during :term:`fit`. Defined only when `X`
has feature names that are all strings.

.. versionadded:: 1.0
attributes.name: feature_names_in_

attributes.description:
Number of iterations run by the optimization routine to fit the model.

.. versionadded:: 1.1
attributes.name: n_iter_

attributes.description: Support vectors. If `X` is sparse, these will also be sparse.
attributes.name: support_vectors_
attributes.type_doc: ndarray or sparse array/matrix of shape (n_SV, n_features)

methods.name: fit
methods.summary: Fit the SVM model according to the given training data.

methods.name: get_metadata_routing
methods.summary: Get metadata routing of this object.

methods.name: predict
methods.summary: Perform regression on samples in X.

methods.name: score
methods.summary: Return :ref:`coefficient of determination <r2_score>` on test data.

methods.name: set_fit_request
methods.signature: set_fit_request(*, sample_weight: bool | None | str = '$UNCHANGED$') -> sklearn.svm._classes.NuSVR
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``fit`` method.

methods.name: set_params
methods.summary: Set the parameters of this estimator.

methods.name: set_score_request
methods.signature: set_score_request(*, sample_weight: bool | None | str = '$UNCHANGED$') -> sklearn.svm._classes.NuSVR
methods.summary: Configure whether metadata should be requested to be passed to the ``score`` method.

parameters.description:
An upper bound on the fraction of training errors and a lower bound of
the fraction of support vectors. Should be in the interval (0, 1].  By
default 0.5 will be taken.
parameters.name: nu

parameters.description:
Penalty parameter C of the error term. For an intuitive visualization
of the effects of scaling the regularization parameter C, see
:ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_svm_plot_svm_scale_c.py`.
parameters.name: C

parameters.description:
Specifies the kernel type to be used in the algorithm.
If none is given, 'rbf' will be used. If a callable is given it is
used to precompute the kernel matrix.
For an intuitive visualization of different kernel types see
See :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_svm_plot_svm_regression.py`
parameters.name: kernel

parameters.description:
Degree of the polynomial kernel function ('poly').
Must be non-negative. Ignored by all other kernels.
parameters.name: degree

parameters.description:
Kernel coefficient for 'rbf', 'poly' and 'sigmoid'.

- if ``gamma='scale'`` (default) is passed then it uses
  1 / (n_features * X.var()) as value of gamma,
- if 'auto', uses 1 / n_features
- if float, must be non-negative.

.. versionchanged:: 0.22
   The default value of ``gamma`` changed from 'auto' to 'scale'.
parameters.name: gamma

parameters.description:
Independent term in kernel function.
It is only significant in 'poly' and 'sigmoid'.
parameters.name: coef0

parameters.description:
Whether to use the shrinking heuristic.
See the :ref:`User Guide <shrinking_svm>`.
parameters.name: shrinking

parameters.description: Specify the size of the kernel cache (in MB).
parameters.name: cache_size

parameters.description:
Enable verbose output. Note that this setting takes advantage of a
per-process runtime setting in libsvm that, if enabled, may not work
properly in a multithreaded context.
parameters.name: verbose

parameters.description: Hard limit on iterations within solver, or -1 for no limit.
parameters.name: max_iter

signature: NuSVR(*, nu=0.5, C=1.0, kernel='rbf', degree=3, gamma='scale', coef0=0.0, shrinking=True, tol=0.001, cache_size=200, verbose=False, max_iter=-1)
